pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/athena/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:180 When the stance read fails (a hole in the gate's own instrument), the error is turned into 'no stance' and the requireHumanApproval check is silently skipped, so an anonymous accept of an AI-originated action goes through exactly when the gate cannot see the policy. The standard requires fail-closed or refuse here, not a silent skip.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/athena/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:180 A read error (gate's own vision) gets the same treatment as 'org published no stance' (subject's world). The approval condition SKIPs silently instead of failing closed or refusing.
src/app/api/athena/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:185 The refusal names the remedy (sign in), and the reader can act on it from where they stand.

src/app/api/cron/athena/route.ts:183 Degraded is not green: errors, truncation and engine-less orgs return 207, never a clean 200. DB-unconfigured returns 503. This is the could-not-run outcome kept apart from pass.
src/app/api/cron/athena/route.ts:107 A recurring reaper on a clock expires stale open proposals and stamps interrupted claims, each with an audit row. Proposals do not sit 'active' forever.
src/app/api/cron/athena/route.test.ts:261 The prose 'COUPLED CONSTANT ... MUST equal' rule (route.ts:44) has a pinning test behind it rather than living only in a comment.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/followups.ts:293 The agent brief is a hand-written projection of the integrity guard's gate-config regex (src/lib/local/lane-gate-diff.ts). It has already drifted downward once: the prose named four tools against ~40 prefixes and lanes voided cycles. The fix restated the list by hand rather than generating it from the guard, and no test pins the two together.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/org/followups.ts:293 The brief is a hand-maintained subset of GATE_CONFIG_BASENAME/GATE_CONFIG_FLEET_BASENAME. Drift was measured (an assistant acted on the subset), yet the projection is still not derived from the one policy object.

src/lib/db/followup-claims.ts:71 Machine claims lease and are swept, but a human hand-off is an in_progress claim with no clock. Recovery depends on someone manually sending it back or releasing it, so abandoned human claims stay counted as held.

src/lib/db/followup-claims.ts:25 The agent's own report_attempt cannot close a row. Only a rescan that measures the dimension moving writes done, so the verdict never rests on the gated party's paperwork.

src/lib/org/followups.ts:296 The freeze on tests, fixtures, CI and gate configs is mechanical: an integrity guard diffs the lane's work and voids the cycle (lane-gate-diff.ts). It is not merely requested in the brief.
